# Delivery service (`@dos/delivery-service`)

Serves the roles **delivery, owner, manager**. Port **3004** (override with `DELIVERY_SERVICE_PORT`). Stateless: run as many replicas as needed (docs/20). Shares one Postgres database and the `@dos/core` modules with the other services (docs/19).

## Run

```bash
pnpm --filter @dos/delivery-service dev    # watch mode on :3004
pnpm --filter @dos/delivery-service test   # smoke spec: health, docs, role gate
open http://localhost:3004/docs           # interactive API reference (Scalar); /docs/openapi.json is the spec
```

Needs the local database (`DATABASE_URL` in the repo-root `.env`; `pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed` once). Until phone-OTP login lands every request carries three headers: `x-tenant-id`, `x-actor-id`, `x-actor-role` (`pnpm db:seed` prints demo ids per role; see docs/18-build-log.md).

Conventions: money is integer paise (₹40.00 = 4000), quantities integer pieces, percentages basis points (5% = 500), ids are client-generated UUIDv7, every write carries an `idempotencyKey` (same key + same payload → same answer; different payload → 409). GET inputs go in the query string. Lists return `{ items, nextCursor }`; pass `cursor` to page.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health/ping` | Liveness + database reachability |
| GET | `/tenancy/me` | Current user, tenant and membership |
| GET | `/catalog/variants` | Search the global product master |
| GET | `/catalog/manufacturers` | Manufacturers with their brands |
| POST | `/catalog/proposals` | Propose a missing product; usable immediately |
| GET | `/tenant-catalog/products` | What this distributor sells (no cost) |
| POST | `/tenant-catalog/products` | List/unlist a variant and set order rules |
| GET | `/tenant-catalog/suppliers` | Suppliers of this distributor |
| POST | `/tenant-catalog/suppliers` | Create or update a supplier |
| GET | `/tenant-catalog/costs` | Purchase costs (owner/manager/accountant only) |
| POST | `/tenant-catalog/costs` | Set purchase cost (owner/manager/accountant only) |
| GET | `/retailers` | Retailers of this distributor (retailer role: only its own, without credit) |
| GET | `/retailers/{id}` | One retailer (retailer role: only its own, without credit) |
| POST | `/retailers` | Create or update a retailer; code is server-assigned |
| POST | `/retailers/{id}/credit` | Set tier and credit terms (owner/manager/accountant only) |
| POST | `/retailers/{id}/link` | Link the retailer to its global identity by phone |
| GET | `/beats` | Beats of this distributor |
| POST | `/beats` | Create or update a beat |
| POST | `/beats/{id}/assign` | Assign a salesperson to a beat for a date range |
| POST | `/visits` | Record a shop visit (own) |
| GET | `/visits` | Visits by retailer / rep / period |
| GET | `/pricing/price-lists` | Price lists with their rates |
| POST | `/pricing/price-lists` | Create or update a price list |
| POST | `/pricing/price-lists/{priceListId}/items` | Set rates on a price list (upsert per variant) |
| GET | `/pricing/overrides` | Retailer-specific rates |
| POST | `/pricing/overrides` | Set a retailer-specific rate |
| GET | `/pricing/schemes` | Schemes (the single table the engine reads) |
| POST | `/pricing/schemes` | Create or update a scheme; a change to its economics bumps the version |
| POST | `/pricing/quote` | Price an order with the pure engine (no side effects) |
| POST | `/pricing/bargains` | Ask for a lower rate; auto-approved within the rep bound |
| POST | `/pricing/bargains/{id}/decide` | Approve or reject a bargain (back office) |
| GET | `/pricing/bargains` | Bargain requests |
| POST | `/pricing/bounds` | How far a rep may discount without asking (owner only) |
| GET | `/inventory/locations` | Stock locations: godown, vehicles, damaged bin |
| POST | `/inventory/locations` | Create or update a stock location |
| GET | `/inventory/sellable` | Available-to-promise stock (the only stock surface for reps and retailers) |
| GET | `/inventory/balances` | On-hand and reserved per lot per location (stock keepers only) |
| POST | `/inventory/adjustments` | Post an opening/adjustment/damage/expiry/cycle-count ledger row |
| POST | `/inventory/transfers` | Move pieces of a lot between locations |
| GET | `/inventory/ledger` | Append-only stock ledger |
| POST | `/inventory/lots` | Find or create a lot (variant + batch + MRP) |
| POST | `/orders` | Create a priced draft order |
| POST | `/orders/{id}/lines` | Replace the lines of a draft and re-price it |
| POST | `/orders/repeat-last` | Draft a repeat of the retailer's last order, re-priced today |
| POST | `/orders/{id}/submit` | Submit: assign the order number, raise approvals or auto-confirm |
| POST | `/orders/{id}/confirm` | Confirm and reserve stock (back office) |
| POST | `/orders/{id}/cancel` | Cancel an order and release its reservations |
| GET | `/orders/{id}` | One order with lines, transitions and approvals |
| GET | `/orders` | Orders (a retailer sees only its own) |
| GET | `/approvals` | Approval queue (back office) |
| POST | `/approvals/{id}/decide` | Approve or reject; the last approval approved confirms the order |
| POST | `/sync/upload` | Offline write batch (never 4xx; rejections are 2xx + sync_errors) |

### GET `/health/ping`

Liveness + database reachability · contract `health.ping`

**Example request**

```bash
curl "http://localhost:3004/health/ping" \
  -H "x-tenant-id: <tenant id>" \
  -H "x-actor-id: <user id>" \
  -H "x-actor-role: delivery"
```

**Success response** — `200`

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "version": "text",
  "db": "up",
  "time": "2026-09-04T10:30:00.000Z"
}
```

**Failure responses**

503 — database not configured / unreachable
```json
{
  "defined": false,
  "code": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
  "status": 503,
  "message": "database is not configured"
}
```

```json
  "status": 400,
  "message": "Input validation failed",
  "data": {
    "issues": [
      {
        "path": [
```
```json
          "phone"
        ],
        "message": "Indian mobile in E.164, e.g. +919876543210"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

409 — same idempotencyKey reused with a different payload (a retry with the same payload returns the stored 200)
```json
{
  "defined": false,
  "code": "CONFLICT",
  "status": 409,
  "message": "idempotencyKey was already used with a different request"
}
```

503 — database not configured / unreachable
```json
{
  "defined": false,
  "code": "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
  "status": 503,
  "message": "database is not configured"
}
```
